name: Catlett Data Center Campus
summary: The applicant withdrew a rezoning for a large data-center campus after organized opposition. Later warehouse preapplication activity means the site should be tracked as redesigned, not treated as permanently undeveloped.
proposal_description: The application sought to rezone roughly 60 acres in the Catlett Service District for a multi-building data-center campus and associated electrical infrastructure.

proposed_scale.label: Proposed campus
proposed_scale.value: Approximately 1.4 million square feet on 60 acres

site_afterlife: Fauquier reporting identifies later preapplication material for a non-distributing warehouse concept. The site is therefore classified as redesigned rather than a clean no-development outcome.
evidence_note: The official record verifies withdrawal. Advocacy reporting supports a contributing community role, while the exact causal weight of opposition versus applicant economics remains unquantified.

timeline.title: Rezoning enters county review
timeline.summary: County materials describe a request to rezone 60 acres for data-center uses in the Catlett Service District.

timeline.title: County agenda records application withdrawal
timeline.summary: The Planning Commission agenda was amended to reflect withdrawal of the rezoning and special-exception applications.

timeline.title: Warehouse concept appears in preapplication material
timeline.summary: A later non-distributing warehouse concept indicates potential redesign of the site rather than a stable untreated parcel.

sources.title: Fauquier County Parks and Recreation referral materials
Planning Commission Public Hearing — amended for Catlett withdrawal
